name: Michalis Hadjipantela - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: Mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund: redundancies in the retail sector in Belgium
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that Belgium should receive €2,661,564 from the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund. This money helps 365 former Match-Smatch supermarket workers in Wallonia find new jobs. It pays for career advice, training, help starting a business, and bonuses for learning digital or language skills. It also gives companies €10,000 for hiring workers aged 50 or over. The fund covers 85% of the total cost of €3,131,252. Parliament approves the decision so the money can be paid out.

- Belgium gets €2.66 million to help 365 former Match-Smatch workers in Wallonia.
- Workers get training, job advice, business support and skill bonuses.
- Parliament approved the plan; the money is then paid from the EU budget.
